objective: Stop bundling ripgrep and fd with HolyAgent and make them prerequisites the user installs, checked by setup and doctor.
scope: Worktree /home/user/holyagent-0.3.2-unbundle, branch release/0.3.2/feat/user-installed-search-tools, cut from the browser-use branch head 3cc15367 (version 0.3.2). Maintainer (verbatim): "remove the bundling of the executables, list them as dependencies instead" and "I mean dependencies for the users". Why: the vendored binaries (about 24 MB committed in the Claude plugin's dist) need an independently verified checksum on every update, which the updater cannot get for fd in every environment, and users can install both tools with their package manager.

A trace of the current code with file:line is at /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-holyagent/43946df6-456d-58c6-bea3-7e958fcb9495/scratchpad/vendored-trace-report.md; read it first. Summary: binaries in packages/integrations/claude/dist/scripts/vendor/{darwin-arm64,linux-x64,windows-x64} with licenses, pinned in packages/integrations/claude/src/vendor.ts, fetched by scripts/vendor.ts (mise `vendor` task, a dependency of `build`), moved by the vendored-binary step of scripts/update-dependencies.ts (VENDOR_PINS, publishedChecksums) and scripts/dependency-pins.ts (VendoredTool, rewriteVendoredTool); the only runtime consumer is `holyagent rg` / `holyagent fd` in packages/runtime/src/cli/tools.ts (BUNDLED_TOOLS, TARGETS, UnsupportedPlatform, ToolMissing), with no PATH fallback; the Pi dist has no vendor folder (so `holyagent rg` there likely fails today).

Wanted: (1) Delete the vendor folder with its binaries and licenses, packages/integrations/claude/src/vendor.ts, scripts/vendor.ts, the mise `vendor` task and its use by `build`, the build exclusion of VENDOR_DIRECTORY, the vendored-binary step of the updater with its pins, checksum lookups and tests, and every test of the bundle. (2) `holyagent rg` and `holyagent fd` stay as the one search interface but run the ripgrep and fd found on PATH (Bun.which with the environment's PATH), passing arguments, stdin, stdout and the exit code through as today. fd is installed as `fdfind` on Debian and Ubuntu, so `holyagent fd` tries `fd` then `fdfind`. When a tool is missing, fail with a tagged error whose message names the tool and the install command per platform (macOS: `brew install ripgrep fd`; Debian/Ubuntu: `sudo apt install ripgrep fd-find`; Fedora: `sudo dnf install ripgrep fd-find`; Arch: `sudo pacman -S ripgrep fd`; Windows: `winget install BurntSushi.ripgrep.MSVC sharkdp.fd`), replacing UnsupportedPlatform and the `mise run vendor` hint. Keep the platform-independent target selection only if something else still needs it. (3) Setup and doctor of both hosts (the Claude plugin's doctor/setup and the Pi doctor/setup; reuse the existing `SystemNeed` kind `command` mechanism in packages/runtime/src/config/capabilities.ts and pi-check.ts where it fits, and add the equivalent check to the Claude doctor) report rg and fd present or missing with the same install hints; a missing tool is a warning that names what stops working (the root's and specialists' `holyagent rg`/`fd` search), not a crash. (4) Development and CI: add ripgrep and fd to the mise `[tools]` of mise.toml at exact current versions (ripgrep 15.2.0 or what the vendor pin says, fd 10.5.1) through mise's registry names, so dev machines and CI, Windows included, have them and the updater's mise-tools step moves them; do not hand-edit bun.lock. (5) Instruction text: the root and specialist requirements (requirements/root/search.md, requirements/specialist/working.md and the per-family copies under requirements/kimi-k3.1, gpt-6, claude-5.5), the coverage phrases in packages/runtime/src/instructions/coverage.ts (for example line ~180 'Search with the ripgrep and fd that ship with the plugin'), and the generated agent files must now say that holyagent rg and fd run the ripgrep and fd installed on the machine, and that when one fails because the tool is missing, search with the system grep/find (or the host's search tools) and report the missing tool. Follow the project skill at /home/user/holyagent-0.3.2-unbundle/.claude/skills/requirements/SKILL.md for editing the requirements tree and regenerating, and the instruction-writing rules at /root/.claude/plugins/synced/03eb801d-6ff6-4373-b5b1-f94edf359a3e_0f3e6ee9-af2e-4c2c-8d3c-9be25ca27713/holyagent/skills/instruction-writing/SKILL.md for the wording. packages/integrations/claude/src/agents.ts gives Bash roles no Grep or Glob because holyagent rg covers them; keep that unless the change makes a role unable to search, and say what you chose. (6) Docs: docs/components.md, docs/decisions.md (add the decision and its reason), docs/development.md (requirements and gates), docs/attributions.md (no longer redistributed), docs/pi/search.md, docs/pi/claude-parity.md and the install docs list ripgrep and fd as user prerequisites with the install commands; README.md only if a line there now misstates it (keep its sections as they are). In AGENTS.md change only the Dependencies sentence that names the vendored ripgrep and fd, so it no longer lists them.

notes:
- fd is pinned at 10.5.2, not the 10.5.1 in the brief. 10.5.2 is the newest stable tag (git ls-remote and mise ls-remote), so `deps:check` stays green. Say if you want 10.5.1.
- ToolMissing now carries only `{tool}` and replaces UnsupportedPlatform. Platform-independent target selection is gone; nothing else used it.
- Doctor prints the rg/fd lines last (`ok   rg: <path>` or a `~` warning). Setup prints them before the settings lines (`= rg: found at <path>` or a `~` hint), so the settings summary stays last. Neither installs anything, `--fix` included, and `--undo` prints no rg/fd lines.
- Claude and Pi share one doctor and setup, so one implementation covers both hosts. I did not use `SystemNeed` kind `command`, because fd needs the `fdfind` fallback and that need is per-capability. I did not add rg/fd to the SessionStart setup notice.
- agents.ts is unchanged in behavior: roles with Bash still get no Grep or Glob and fall back to the system grep and find through Bash. I only updated the comments.
- `docs/pi/claude-parity.md` has no ripgrep/fd row (its "vendored" is about design skills), so I left it alone.
- The installers `install/wsl-install.sh` and `install/windows-install.ps1` are outside my ownership paths. They still do not install ripgrep or fd, and the docs say so. Having them install both would be a follow-up.
- Pi bash is just-bash, which implements its own `rg` (docs/pi/shell.md). I did not check how that interacts with `holyagent rg` there.
- `plugin.test.ts` keeps a stale-file removal test but drops the vendored-tools exception.
- One mid-task mistake, fixed: I truncated `setup.test.ts` with a bad script, restored it from HEAD and re-applied my edits. The final tree is verified.
